subject: Governed software-construction control behavior after consolidation

protocol.design: Frozen blinded comparative evaluation followed by one-shot holdout
protocol.comparison: Governed candidate versus competent guarded baseline

publicFinding.summary: The consolidated governance system was evaluated under unseen conditions after its control plane was materially simplified. The public claim is limited to evidence that the surviving system preserved legitimate-operation completion while retaining discrimination against adverse governance conditions within the frozen evaluation protocol.
supports: legitimate-operation preservation within the tested protocol
adverse-condition discrimination within the tested protocol
doesNotSupport: publication of secret seeds, private oracle material or hidden evaluation payloads

relationshipToTechnologyReadiness.boundary: Generation 3 is supporting evidence for the existing bounded Software TRL 7 self-assessment. It does not independently create the TRL 7 claim and does not advance the platform to TRL 8.

publicationBoundary.reason: This public summary records the frozen evaluation structure and authorized conclusion without exposing private evaluation material or asserting unsupported numerical results.
